storage: OpenBao secret path for automation plus Vaultwarden recovery item for human break-glass
rotation: on credential change, after suspected exposure, after host trust changes, or during scheduled rotation
backup: Vaultwarden encrypted backup/export plus OpenBao snapshot backup; no Git copy, encrypted or otherwise
recovery_test: fetch a non-production canary secret from OpenBao and verify a restored Vaultwarden item without printing values
blast_radius: limited to the consuming service and explicit OpenBao/Vaultwarden scopes
revocation: revoke or rotate at the source service, then update OpenBao and Vaultwarden recovery item

type: unseal/recovery keys and root-token retirement evidence
storage: Vaultwarden emergency item plus offline break-glass copy; never GitHub
rotation: after bootstrap, after operator changes, or after suspected exposure
backup: Vaultwarden encrypted backup/export plus independent offline copy
recovery_test: prove OpenBao can be unsealed/restored in a controlled drill without exposing key material
blast_radius: could unlock or administer the automation vault if combined with access to the OpenBao service
revocation: rotate recovery shares/root material and retire bootstrap tokens

type: admin token, database encryption context, export password, and backup credentials
storage: offline break-glass plus carefully scoped Vaultwarden record where appropriate; never GitHub
rotation: after bootstrap, after restore drills, after suspected exposure, or admin change
backup: encrypted Vaultwarden database/export backup plus offsite/offline copy
recovery_test: restore a backup into an isolated disposable Vaultwarden instance and confirm item counts/metadata only
blast_radius: could expose the human/recovery vault if combined with database/export access
revocation: rotate admin token/export passwords and invalidate old sessions
